scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-local-config.mjs && docker compose up -d --wait db && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @product-finder/api" "npm run dev -w @product-finder/web"
scripts.test:integration: docker compose --profile test up -d --wait test-db && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://product_finder:product_finder@localhost:5433/product_finder_test npm run test:integration -w @product-finder/api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
